audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2-5 all said Yorick (or Skill) while the packet chart and the page's own whys say Kayle for every one of them — whys[2] through whys[5] each end with the literal words 'so this stage is Kayle's' / 'the first-item window is Kayle's'. Difficulty 8.5/10 also fought a 56.8% win rate.
audit.why: Yorick is slow and dash-less; from level 6 ranged Divine Ascent clears the ghoul pack from outside swarm range. He only reclaims the game at 2+ items via the splitpush.
audit.corrected: Yorick, Yorick, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Yorick. Difficulty 6/10, Yorick carry threat 7/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Yorick levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Yorick late splitpush.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice on the page. Dark Procession was never given a cooldown or described as destructible, and Mourning Mist — the ability that actually aims his swarm — had no number anywhere.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s, cast at 600 range, and Riot's own text calls it a DESTRUCTIBLE wall — you can break out, which changes the whole 'never get caged' framing. Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8s at 700 range and reduces armor, slows and marks you so his summons gain move speed toward you; side-stepping the mark is the concrete counterplay. Last Rites is a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s auto-attack reset that heals him.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns, the destructibility of the wall and the auto-reset tell now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal named only in itemization; dontsFull[1].d was unrelated boilerplate.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on a 6s cooldown at rank 1 — chip without Grievous Wounds is refunded every few seconds.

notes: focus.text is 'Yorick Dark Procession' (22 chars, under the 25-char skip threshold so I did not propose a change) — but the ability Kayle must actually track is MOURNING MIST, not the wall: the E mark is what aims the ghoul pack and Maiden at her, and the page's own early/mid prose says exactly that. The loading line and dosFull[0].t both point at Dark Procession too. Worth a follow-up pass if focus.text can be rewritten. Riot's text calls Dark Procession destructible, which the old 'never get caged' framing hid — the reader should know they can break out.
